Episode: E006: Fatima Ronquillo and Justin Wheatley
Long Description: Fatima Ronquillo is a self-taught artist who is constantly working to explore her own identity through painting. Long Description: "Ask Eleven" features BYU professor David Magleby hosting a public affairs discussion with Utah Governor Gary Herbert. The program invites viewers and students to engage directly by phone, email, and social media, asking questions on key policy issues. Topics include the Healthy Utah healthcare initiative, Medicaid funding concerns, and debates around the Affordable Care Act. The discussion also covers growth in Utah, transportation funding challenges, and proposed gas tax increases. Governor Herbert addresses prison relocation, economic development, and air quality, including wood-burning regulations and vehicle emissions. Additional segments explore capital punishment policies, marijuana legislation, gun laws, education funding, and efforts to balance religious freedom with LGBT protections. The program highlights Utah’s legislative priorities, economic outlook, and public policy challenges while emphasizing civic engagement and informed dialogue.

Long Description: Austin ventures into one of the world's last wildernesses, the Great Bear Rainforest in western Canada, in search of the park's most dangerous inhabitant. The Grizzly Bear can kill a man with a single swipe of its paw but it is by nature elusive and shy. Austin has timed his journey perfectly. He will be making his way up river into the heart of the rainforest following the annual salmon run--the bear's main food source. Along the way, he will have to cross some of the most rugged and impenetrable terrain on earth and be on constant alert for black bears and Grizzlies.

Short Description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Xtra Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the First Presidency.

Press Title: President Dallin H. Oaks | The Great Plan
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "We who know God’s plan and who have covenanted to participate have a clear responsibility to teach these truths."
Short Description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: President Dallin H. Oaks of the First Presidency.

Press Title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | The Blessing of Continuing Revelation to Prophets and Personal Revelation to Guide Our Lives
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Continuous revelation has been received and is being received through channels the Lord has established."
Short Description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | Come and Belong
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We invite all of God’s children throughout the world to join us in this great endeavor."
Short Description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Sharing the Message of the Restoration and the Resurrection
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "The Restoration belongs to the world, and its message is especially urgent today."
Short Description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: President Russell M. Nelson | Go Forward in Faith
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I bless you with peace and increasing faith in the Lord."
Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Xtra Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the First Presidency.

Press Title: President Russell M. Nelson | Moving Forward
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The work of the Lord is steadily moving forward."
Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Xtra Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the First Presidency.

Press Title: Elder David A. Bednar | We Will Prove Them Herewith
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Now is the time to prepare and prove ourselves willing and able to do all things whatsoever the Lord our God shall command us."
Short Description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Sister Michelle D. Craig | Eyes to See
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Sister Michelle D. Craig, First Counselor of the Young Women General Presidency. "Through the power of the Holy Ghost, Christ will enable us to see ourselves and see others as He does."
Short Description: Sister Michelle D. Craig, First Counselor of the Young Women General Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: Sister Michelle D. Craig, Young Women General Presidency.

Press Title: Elder Quentin L. Cook | Hearts Knit in Righteousness and Unity
Long Description: Elder Cook encourages members to be a Zion people and dwell in righteousness, becoming an oasis of unity while celebrating diversity.
Medium Description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "At this 200-year hinge point in our Church history, let us commit ourselves to live righteously and be united as never before."
Short Description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Quentin L. Cook of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Elder Ronald A. Rasband | Recommended to the Lord
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Begin the process now to become 'recommended to the Lord' so that His Spirit will be with you in abundance."
Short Description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Ronald A. Rasband, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Love Your Enemies
Long Description: President Oaks teaches that, with the Savior’s help, it is possible to obey and seek to improve our nation’s laws and also to love our adversaries and our enemies.
Medium Description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "Knowing that we are all children of God gives us a vision of the worth of others and the ability to rise above prejudice."
Short Description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: President Dallin H. Oaks of the First Presidency.

Press Title: Elder D. Todd Christofferson | Sustainable Societies
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "If enough of us and enough of our neighbors strive to guide our lives by the truth of God, the moral virtues needed in every society will abound."
Short Description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder D. Todd Christofferson, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Elder Gerrit W. Gong | All Nations, Kindreds, and Tongues
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "We can become, in our own way, part of the fulfillment of the Lord’s prophecies and promises—part of the gospel blessing the world."
Short Description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Gerrit W. Gong of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf | God Will Do Something Unimaginable
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "God has prepared His children and His Church for this time."
Short Description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Dieter F. Uchtdorf, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Sister Sharon Eubank | By Union of Feeling We Obtain Power with God
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Sister Sharon Eubank, First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency. "As we seek union of feeling, we will call down the power of God to make our efforts whole."
Short Description: Sister Sharon Eubank, First Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: Sister Sharon Eubank, Relief Society General Presidency.

Press Title: Sister Becky Craven | Keep the Change
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Sister Becky Craven, Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency. "Through Jesus Christ, we are given the strength to make lasting changes. As we humbly turn to Him, He will increase our capacity to change."
Short Description: Sister Becky Craven, Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: Sister Becky Craven of the Young Women General Presidency.

Press Title: Sister Cristina B. Franco | The Healing Power of Jesus Christ
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Sister Cristina B. Franco, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "As we come unto Jesus Christ by exercising faith in Him, repenting, and making and keeping covenants, our brokenness—whatever its cause—can be healed."
Short Description: Sister Cristina B. Franco, Second Counselor in the Primary General Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: Sister Cristina B. Franco of the Primary General Presidency.

Press Title: President Henry B. Eyring | Sisters in Zion
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "You will be an essential force in the gathering of Israel and in the creation of a Zion people."
Short Description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: President Henry B. Eyring of the First Presidency.

Press Title: President Dallin H. Oaks | Be of Good Cheer
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency. "Our unshakable faith in the doctrine of the restored gospel of Jesus Christ guides our steps and gives us joy."
Short Description: President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: President Dallin H. Oaks of the First Presidency.

Press Title: President Russell M. Nelson | Embrace the Future with Faith
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "The future will be glorious for those who are prepared and who continue to prepare to be instruments in the Lord’s hands."
Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Xtra Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the First Presidency.

Press Title: President M. Russell Ballard | Watch Ye Therefore, and Pray Always
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Today I expand my call for prayer to all people from every country around the world."
Short Description: President M. Russell Ballard, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: President M. Russell Ballard, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Sister Lisa L. Harkness | Peace, Be Still
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Sister Lisa L. Harkness, First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency. "The Savior teaches us how to feel peace and calm even when the winds blow fiercely around us and billowing waves threaten to sink our hopes."
Short Description: Sister Lisa L. Harkness, First Counselor in the Primary General Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: Sister Lisa L. Harkness of the Primary General Presidency.

Press Title: Elder Ulisses Soares | Seek Christ in Every Thought
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Fighting against temptation takes a lifetime of diligence and faithfulness. But please know that the Lord is ready to assist us."
Short Description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Elder Neil L. Andersen | We Talk of Christ
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "As the world speaks less of Jesus Christ, let us speak more of Him."
Short Description: Elder Neil L. Andersen of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Neil L. Andersen, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: President Russell M. Nelson | Let God Prevail
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "Are you willing to let God prevail in your life? Are you willing to let God be the most important influence in your life?"
Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Xtra Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the First Presidency.

Press Title: President Henry B. Eyring | Tested, Proved, and Polished
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency. "The greatest blessing that will come when we prove ourselves faithful to our covenants during our trials will be a change in our natures."
Short Description: President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency.
Xtra Short Description: President Henry B. Eyring of the First Presidency.

Press Title: Elder Gary E. Stevenson | Highly Favored of the Lord
Long Description: Watch highlights from general conferences of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Medium Description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "Times of affliction and disappointment do not change the watchful eye of the Lord as He favorably looks upon us, blessing us."
Short Description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Gary E. Stevenson, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Press Title: Elder Dale G. Renlund | Do Justly, Love Mercy, and Walk Humbly with God

Medium Description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. "To do justly means acting honorably. We act honorably with God by walking humbly with Him. We act honorably with others by loving mercy."
Short Description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Short Description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.
Xtra Short Description: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles.

Medium Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. "I invite you to turn your heart, mind, and soul increasingly to our Heavenly Father and His Son, Jesus Christ."
Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
Xtra Short Description: President Russell M. Nelson of the First Presidency.

If New Roots receives the grain mill they've dreamed of, they can purchase corn from Haitian citizens, combat unemployment, and supply low-cost grain. Watch The Fixers and New Roots Haiti grab hammers to forge a new future!

In the remote village of Warnes, Bolivia, the team unites with the local people to construct a communally run restaurant and eco-tourism center. Working with Sustainable Bolivia, the Fixers will build the center from the ground up using the villagers' traditional construction methods and adding a few special touches "Fixers style!"

The facility is in dire need of an update—so the Fixers build a brand new kennel area and a "mock home" training area. The goal is to give the dogs and vets an effective training area and room to develop as the organization continues to grow—and save lives…two at a time.

While they are on-site, they discover a small elementary school in desperate need of repair. The Fixers survey the ground, dig the well and take on the monumental task of updating the elementary school. The mission was to provide fresh water—but it became so much more.

They will provide the teenage orphans the opportunity to learn practical mechanical skills, including welding, changing oil, engine maintenance, woodworking and a host of other specialties—giving them the chance to improve their future by entering the job market with a professionally honed craft.

They’ve purchased the building next door, but they need help creating a warm, comfortable space where parents and their children can stay and while they get the help they need. And the need is great because winter is coming, and winters in Wyoming can be brutal. But the Fixers will do whatever it takes to get the job done.

The center helps children learn to use wheelchairs and other adaptive equipment. The center is very high tech but is missing one crucial item – a repair shop for the equipment. Wheelchairs are difficult to get in Mexico, so having the ability to make repairs is crucial. The Fixers will pull out all the stops to make this build happen.

Long Description: The Fixers head up the Tonle Sap River in Cambodia to help The Lake Clinic restore one of their floating medical clinics. This clinic is the only medical facility around for miles and is vital to the people in this remote area. The Fixers will update the clinic with a new floating dock, roof, kitchen, and floor. And as a special treat, they’ll turn the original Lake Clinic boat into a relaxing oasis for the doctors and midwives when the workday is over.

Long Description: The Fixers head to South LA to team up with Concerned Back Men of Los Angeles. Here they will turn an abandoned barbershop into CBMLA’s new home. Trying to rebuild a dilapidated building in a week is hard—doing it during a worldwide epidemic may prove impossible. But the Fixers are determined to get it done for Juneteeth.

Long Description: The Fixers stay stateside and journey to Pine Bluff, Arkansas, to work with TOPPS, a program dedicated to providing hot meals and a safe space for children after school. In an area where one in four children go hungry, this program is vital to the community. The Fixers find the TOPPS facility in need of an overhaul and install a new kitchen, build a learning lab, level floors, and build a new playground.

The local professional team, the Arecibo Capitanes, has been playing on the same court for decades and it’s slowly falling into disrepair. The Fixers will rehabilitate the court and team up with some local artists to create murals that will draw in crowds and add some beauty to these hallowed sporting grounds.

The Fixers will build the bakery from the ground up and furnish it with industrial kitchen appliances. They will also include a cozy cafe for guests. The women have learned how to prepare many baked goods, and with their new bakery they will be able to support themselves.

Long Description: The Fixers are heading to Grand Rapids, Michigan, to help world champion kickboxer Dino Newville of Blue’s Gym. The gym is a safe haven for the city’s at risk youth, but it needs work. So The Fixers will rebuild a damaged karate studio and build a new jiu jitsu studio to help the gym stay afloat. And while they’re there, The Fixers will tackle a special project for Dino and his wife, Sara.

Once there, they team up with Project Maji to build water filtration kiosks for the local community. With the support of dedicated volunteers, The Fixers construct these systems, providing the village with reliable access to clean, fresh drinking water.

Tasked with building a shower house for the herders and pens and bath areas for livestock, the team quickly realizes these projects are far tougher than they thought, as harsh weather and limited materials put their skills to the test.

Long Description: The Fixers travel to Athens, Greece, and meet up with We Need Books, an organization that provides local youth with a safe space to read, learn, and connect with other kids their age. With dedication and the support of many community volunteers, the Fixers renovate the library and create an engaging new space for the youth in Athens. Throughout the build, they hear powerful stories of hope, survival, and bravery as they grow closer to the founders of We Need Books.

Long Description: The Fixers travel to Togo in West Africa, where they meet Marie-Alix De Putter, founder of the Bluemind Foundation. As they hear her story and the mission behind the organization, they realize just how vital their project will be in supporting teens across Africa facing mental health challenges. With this understanding, the team gets to work creating a unique space that includes a hair salon, a call center, and areas for meditation and relaxation, designed to better serve and uplift the community.

Long Description: In Nepal, the Fixers work with Paint the Globe Foundation to remodel a classroom that will serve under-served Nepali women, providing them with a space to pursue academic and professional growth. Beyond their project, the Fixers immerse themselves in Nepal’s rich cultural heritage, exploring the unique coexistence of Buddhism and Hinduism. They visit sacred sites from both traditions, gaining insight into their similarities, differences, and the harmonious way these faiths intertwine in daily life.

Long Description: The Fixers go to Khayelitsha, South Africa, just outside of Cape Town, to assist Orchard: Africa, an organization that trains the African people how to live sustainability. The Fixers will build a training facility for community leaders to learn about the various techniques of vertical gardening to teach to the people back home.  With Day Zero, a day in Cape Town where no water can be used, possibly around the corner, the Fixers urgently need to make this place ready to educate the people.

Long Description: The fixers stay stateside to help out the White Mountain Apache Tribe near Fort Apache, Arizona. With guidance from their contact, Clayton Harvey — garden and greenhouse manager for the Ndee Bikiyaa (People’s Farm) — they will transform a former saddlery to a fresh produce market, enabling local farmers and the community the opportunity to sell their produce and restore their local heritage.

Episode: E007: Association of the Beatitudes- Peru
Long Description: The Fixers travel to Lima, Peru to help Father Omar Sánchez Portillo, who runs Asociación de las Bienaventuranzas (Association of the Beatitudes), an organization that gives abandoned special needs children and adults a home. As theteam develops a recycling facility, refurbishes a granulator, and creates safe work spaces for the residents, they discover their true mission: to give these adults purpose.
Medium Description: The Fixers travel to Lima, Peru to help Asociación de las Bienaventuranzas, an organization that gives abandoned special needs people a home. They build a recycling facility to help the organization generate money and promote recycling in Lima.

The island is in disrepair and desperately needs the Fixers help. The Fixers will transform the island with an outdoor kitchen, painted cabins, and a firepit where the healing "warriors circle" can take place. They will also build a scenic dock to give the veterans a space for quiet reflection.

Transforming a chicken-fish farm into a central protein source for a remote elementary school in the mountains will demand digging and designing like none other. Between heavy rains and power outages, time is running out to finish everything on schedule.

Xtra Short Description: The Fixers help Global Village Connect build a farm.

Long Description: The Fixers are off to Nueva Esperanza, Ecuador, to work with CAEMBA, an organization that builds bamboo homes for underprivileged women. But the Fixers are building something bigger than a home—they’re building a trade school for women that will house a sewing school, a kitchen, a bamboo wood shop, and a nursery for the kids.

This intensive project of erecting a horse arena, a fence, and an obstacle course for orphans of all ages will prove demanding; However, if they can create a safe space for those with reactive attachment disorder every drop of sweat will be well worth it.
Medium Description: The Fixers travel to Plovdiv, Bulgaria to help One Heart Bulgaria, an organization that helps Bulgarian orphans. They will build a horse arena and sensory obstacle course to give orphans, both young and old a new type of therapy.

Long Description: The Fixers head to the Navajo Nation to create a garden project at the Red Valley/Cove High School, the smallest school in the state.  Fresh produce is incredibly difficult to find on the reservation, as there are only 10 supermarkets on the entire reservation which spans over 27,000  square miles. And creating a school program that teaches the children an agricultural curriculum may be just the thing to attract more students from the area and keep the doors open on this vital learning spot.

The women of the cooperative have been manufacturing products out of Claudia’s kitchen, but now they are ready for their first pineapple processing factory, and The Fixers want to make that a reality.

Long Description: The Fixers travel to Costa Rica, the land of Pura Vida.  Their mission is to help the women in the small town of San Jose de la Pinilla by creating a space where they can sell their local, artisanal goods, along with a space to cook and bake local delicacies that can be sold to the public. Many tourists pass through this town on their way to surf, but don’t stop in town.  The Fixers aim to change that and provide a source of income and empowerment for the women.

Hunter’s Greave has been used as a scout camp since the mid 70’s, but in recent years has fallen on hard times and is in danger of shutting down completely. This build will provide the children of Leeds a safe, fun way to experience all that nature has to offer. But as always, time is short and this build needs to start now.

They will be working with ROMP - Range of Motion Project, who bring prosthetic devices to the people who need them.  They have a clinic that can make and outfit devices, but no place to train the patients on how to use their prosthesis. This park will give the patients the confidence to go forward in life,  but as always, the clock is ticking
Medium Description: The Fixers travel to Zacapa, Guatemala, to build a mobility lab so newly-amputated patients can test out their prosthesis on a variety of terrain.

The goal of the ranch is to  empower lives through social, residential and vocational opportunities.  Many adults with Downs syndrome suffer from obesity and other health problems.  The Fixers build a gym that can service all of the people that attend Down Home Ranch.  Because a healthy life is a happy life.

From there, the Fixers get to work, partnering with students from Pullman Tech to transform the workshop and create a lasting impact for future participants in the program.

In the Gym Stars challenge, Nile Wilson and Luke Strong take on the Acro squad to see who’s the ultimate in handstand trickery.

Long Description: It’s not good news for Chase, who heads to the hospital after suffering an injury at the gym and has a nervous wait to find out how long he’ll be out of action. Meanwhile, Acro duo Dylan and Lola join the Acro squad for their first big international competition in Portugal where the team take on the mighty Russian Team, who has the reputation of being one of the best in the world!

Episode: E019: This is Where it Starts
Long Description: It's the Artistic British Championships, and the juniors are up on day one. Alice is competing for the first time at junior level and has strong competition as she’s up against Amelie and Phoebe’s teammates from the European championships. All seems to be going well until she’s struck by a severe case of nerves, and it looks as though her competition is in jeopardy. Meanwhile Ekraj is late for podium training and doesn’t seem very focused on the competition; teammate James is looking strong but now has to help coach Karen get Ekraj back on track. Will any of our juniors be able to pull a great performance out of the bag and do themselves proud in Liverpool?

Long Description: It's the Youth Olympic Games in Argentina, and Amelie has been selected as the only female artistic gymnast to represent Great Britain. Great news for Amelie, but this means she’ll be leaving best friend and training partner Phoebe behind. But Phoebe is her number-one supporter and is busy making sure Amelie gets the sendoff she deserves. Dom Cunningham turns his hand to ribbon throwing as he takes on the Rhythmic girls in the Gym Stars challenge!

Episode: E015: When The Going Gets Tough
Long Description: With just a week to go until the British Championships, the Rhythmic team is struggling to learn a complicated new routine for the competition. But a surprise visit from a Rhythmic celebrity goes a long way to lift the girls’ spirits. Back at the artistic gym, everyone’s looking forward to welcoming Amelie back from the Youth Olympics. And it's a test of strength and stamina as Dom Cunningham and Joe Fraser go head to head with Corey and Luke in the Gym Stars challenge.

Episode: E001: Road to the Olympics: The First Time in Forever
Press Title: Road to the Olympics: The First Time in Forever
Press Title - Sort: Road to the Olympics: The First Time in Forever
Press Title - Short: Road to the Olympics: The First Time in Forever
Long Description: Amelie, a talented gymnast, has earned a spot in the Senior female team for the European Championships after her remarkable performance at the Junior European championships. Despite being the youngest and missing her training partner Phoebe, Amelie is determined to excel. Phoebe, along with gymnast Alice, will be there to support her. Amelie's goal is to impress the GB coaches and secure a place in the Olympic team. Meanwhile, Nile Wilson returns to Gym Stars for another challenge, determined to win after losing in Series 2. He sets a strength test for the Acro Squad to determine who has the strongest biceps. Lastly, Madi selects Alice Kinsella, the 2018 Commonwealth Games champion and 2019 European Champion on the beam, as her top gymnast for the Olympics.
Medium Description: Artistic gymnast Amelie represents Team GB for her first ever European Championships as a senior. Meanwhile, Nile Wilson is back for another round of Gym Stars challenges. And finally, Madi choses her very own Gym Stars Top 20 gymnast .
Short Description: Artistic gymnast Amelie represents Team GB for her first ever European Championships as a senior.
Xtra Short Description: Artistic gymnast Amelie represents Team GB.

Long Description: It’s Amelie and Phoebe’s turn to head to the Artistic British Championships, and for the first time ever, they will be competing as seniors, which means they’ll be up against their gymnastic heroes, and the competition will be tough! Phoebe has a new move on the uneven bars, and Amelie is going to perform her new floor routine. With such strong competition will the girls be able to hold their nerve and make an impression in their first British as seniors?

Long Description: Acro gymnast George has had enough of people misunderstanding his sport, so he decides to give a presentation to his classmates at school to let them know what it’s really like to be a world-class acrobatic gymnast. Trampoline gymnast Corey returns home from the World Championships in Russia, and the gym holds a mini "World Champs" competition to celebrate his success. And James and Ekraj spend some time together out of the gym where they talk about the British Championships, which is just weeks away.

Long Description: With the South West Championships looming for the Acro squad, two partnerships are determined to put on a top performance. It's the first time Harry and George will be competing since George broke his arm and was told he’d never be able to do gym again. And the squad’s newest partnership, Dove and Nyree, are determined to prove they are ready to take on the world, but first they need to find some leotards! Meanwhile, Olympic medalist Luke Strong takes on the trampolinists in the Gym Stars challenge.

Episode: E012: When They Call Out Your Name

Press Title - Sort: When They Call Out Your Name
Press Title - Short: When They Call Out Your Name
Long Description: Trampoline gymnast Corey is back at the trampoline British championships. He won the title of British Champion for his age group last year, but he’s moved up and is now the youngest in his category. But Corey’s not one to let a small point of being one of the youngest in his group hold him back, and he’s determined to prove he has the skills for a spot on the podium. Meanwhile acrobatic gymnastic partners Finn and Kirsten have been invited to showcase their talents to some younger gymnasts and hand out medals at the annual awards ceremony.
Medium Description: Trampoline gymnast Corey is back at the trampoline British championships. He won the title of British Champion for his age group last year, but he’s moved up and is now the youngest in his category.
Short Description: Trampoline gymnast Corey is back at the trampoline British championships.
Xtra Short Description: Corey returns to trampoline championships.

Long Description:
In London, Winston and his GB teammates are on their way to France but there’s a last-minute change in the line-up and Winston’s teammate Gabriel has been called in to join the squad. The two boys have been friends for years and sharing a room at the hotel together means they have a chance to chill out and have fun ahead of the competition.

The boys will go head-to-head against some of the best gymnasts in Europe - from France, Switzerland, and Germany.  The competition throws up one challenge after the next and the boys have to think on their feet.  Winston needs to keep all his wits about him to keep on track – but if he can do this, the rewards will be huge.

In East Sussex, rhythmic girls –Poppy, Clea, Martha, Bella and Cherry join a team of litter pickers intent on cleaning up the coastline to keep dangerous plastics away from the marine wildlife.
Medium Description: The rhythmic girls are off on a beach clean while Winston competes in France.
Short Description: The rhythmic girls are off on a beach clean while Winston competes in France.
Xtra Short Description: The rhythmic girls clean a beach. Winston in France.
Tiny Description: The rhythmic girls clean a beach.

Long Description: Trampolinists Morgan and Alannah were inseparable, training hard as a synchro pair. But their partnership ended, and Morgan began training alone. Now, she's partnered with Martha, who also trained individually. Morgan and Martha face a steep learning curve as a synchro pair, needing to perfect their routine and synchronize their moves. Both girls are recovering from Covid, adding to the challenge. Coach Carl must assess their readiness for competition. To ease the pressure and bond, they go roller skating, discovering its difficulty. Gymnast Winston had a setback at the British Championships but regained composure to secure sixth place. Now at Lilleshall, he faces evaluation among Britain's top male gymnasts. Winston's intense training aims to impress the coaches and secure a spot on GB's National Team. The pressure is on.
Medium Description: Morgan and Martha join forces, and Winston aims for selection to the National Team.
Short Description: Morgan and Martha join forces, and Winston aims for selection to the National Team.
Xtra Short Description: Morgan and Martha team, Winston aims to win.
Tiny Description: Morgan and Martha team, Winston has aims

Long Description: In Bristol, gymnasts Emily and Kacey prepare for the English Championships. Emily overcame nerves to compete internationally and won silver at the British Championships, but her back is sore. Kacey recovered from an injury and moved up a category, competing against her friend Emily. Both are nervous as their idols, including Alice Kinsella and the Gadirova twins, will be there. In Birmingham, gymnasts Winston, Trumaine, Zion, and Gabe await news about their futures. Winston placed 4th at the British Championships and won a silver medal in France. They hope their success will elevate them to a higher squad. Trumaine, Chase, and Zion also anticipate news about making it onto the England squad. Olympic gymnasts Dom Cunningham and Joe Fraser participate in the Gym Stars challenge, trying their hand at juggling alongside rhythmic girls.
Medium Description: Emily and Kacey head to The English Champs and the boys get some long awaited news.
Short Description: Emily and Kacey head to The English Champs and the boys get some long awaited news.
Xtra Short Description: Emily and Kacey at Champs. More news.
Tiny Description: Emily and Kacey at Champs. More news.

Episode: E020: Facing up to the Future
Long Description: Artistic gymnast Alice left Devon to train with the best in Bristol, aiming for a scholarship at an American University. However, a neck injury forces her to make a tough decision: continue gymnastics and risk long-term damage, or give up her dreams. Undeterred, she explores alternatives to stay connected to gymnastics if she quits. Regardless, she plans to deliver a memorable final performance. Winston, another gymnast, overcame competition anxiety and achieved success. He placed 5th in the British Championships and contributed to a podium finish in France. Now 17, he faces his greatest challenge yet at The English Championships in the under 18's category. Can he conquer his nerves and perform his best routines against tough rivals?
Medium Description: Artistic Gymnast Alice puts on the performance of her career for an emotional crowd.
Short Description: Artistic Gymnast Alice puts on the performance of her career for an emotional crowd.
Xtra Short Description: Alice gives a performance.

Long Description: The Junior Rhythmic Team, after weeks of training, prepares for their first appearance since lockdown at the National Championships. Poppy joins the team, and they aim to enjoy the experience. The challenging rhythmic performances require synchronization and mastery of the apparatus. Success here could lead to representing Great Britain. Alida, a bronze medalist, decides to transition to coaching. She faces the task of informing her coach and finding new gymnasts. Gymnasts Joe Fraser and Dominic Cunningham present a tough challenge for our Gym Stars.
Medium Description: The Rhythmic team are off to The Nationals an Alida makes a life changing decision.
Short Description: The Rhythmic team are off to The Nationals an Alida makes a life changing decision.
Xtra Short Description: Rythmic team is off. Alida makes choices.
Tiny Description: Rythmic team is off. Alida makes choices

Long Description: Trumaine's recent bad luck: injury, Covid, affecting stamina and fitness. Now a sore finger worries him for his performances. He joins Chase and Zion for the English Championships. Zion battles self-doubt, seeks to prove himself. Pumped for the competition, they face challenges, need inner strength. Trampolinists Martha and Morgan receive news that may alter plans. Gymnasts Joe Fraser and Dominic Cunningham face gym stars in a skipping challenge.
Medium Description: The artistic boys head to The English Championships but Chase’s comeback is under threat.
Short Description: The artistic boys head to The English Championships but Chase’s comeback is under threat.

Long Description:
When the song Holly has been writing in Nasvhille gets rejected, she decides to take matters into her own hands. Determined to prove that her song is truly great, Holly performs it in front of a live crowd - it’s a smash hit! Holly is blindsided when an audience member reveals himself as the pop star who rejected Holly’s song: Justin Lewis - a famous actor. Later, Holly is shocked when she hears that Justin cancelled the songwriting camp. Defeated, Holly heads home but gets a call from Justin: he cancelled the camp because he’s moving to Collinsville to write his entire album with Holly!

Robbie finds himself in over his head when orders for his jam come flooding in. Robbie decides to hire his best friend Warren to help out with the business, but quickly learns that Warren is not up for the task. Robbie eventually realizes that to be a great CEO he has to make some tough decisions and needs to start acting like a grown up… by asking Mom for help.

Long Description:
Holly and Amy reunite after a summer apart. When Holly tells Amy about Justin Lewis coming to Collinsville, she enlists her help to organize a secret welcome bonfire for Justin. Although Holly swears Amy to secrecy, not before long, Amy spills the beans to Savannah, one of Justin’s biggest fans, (and the last person on earth who can keep things on the down low). Amy vouches for Savannah to Holly, getting Savannah invited to the bonfire, but when Justin superfans ambush the event, Amy accuses Savannah of sharing the secret. Robbie does some investigating to find out that the leak came from Justin himself, in the hopes of gaining publicity. Amy apologizes to Savannah for judging her, making amends by organizing a group hangout with her, Holly, and Justin. 

Heather worries she’s losing Levi as a friend when he starts taking up dance. Heather heads to Levi’s dance tryouts to pull him away when she discovers she’s a natural dancer!

Long Description: While looking for inspiration for their next song in town, Holly and Justin have a strange interaction with Farmer Dodge. When Justin starts acting different, Holly brings up what happened with her family. Heather helps Holly realize that what she witnessed was Farmer Dodge racially profiling Justin. Dodge assumed Holly was in trouble just because Justin is Black. After hearing from Amy and Savannah that they too have experienced racism in Collinsville, Holly becomes determined to seek justice on Justin’s behalf. After confronting Farmer Dodge, Holly tries to convince Justin to join her in a protest and help write a song about what happened - but Justin wants nothing to do with it. Holly decides to respect Justin’s wishes, and on her own starts educating herself and her family on racial inequality.

Long Description: Autistic heroine Addie faces challenges in a new school year. Her sensory overload worsens with a change in classroom and losing her best friend. A meltdown during a field trip leads her to a witch jar. Addie learns about Lady Margaret Fraser and decides to honor the witches. With support from new friend Audrey, she prepares a speech for a witch memorial. They discover a mysterious mark and Addie's confidence wavers. Despite presenting her case to the council, her application is rejected. A vlog about autism causes tension, but Addie receives a letter and an old key, hoping it holds clues about Lady Margaret's disappearance.
Medium Description: A field trip ignites Addie's (Lola Blue) desire to solve a centuries-old mystery: what happened to Lady Margaret Fraser? With the help of her older sisters Keedie (Georgia De Gidlow) and Nina (Caitlyn Hamilton), Addie begins her search for answers.
Short Description: A field trip sparks Addie's quest to solve a centuries-old mystery.
Xtra Short Description: Addie uncovers a centuries-old mystery.

Long Description: Addie prepares to present her witch memorial case to Juniper town council, supported by her new friend Audrey. They discover a mysterious spiral mark near the old witch tree. Nina helps Addie with her appearance for the meeting and records a vlog about autism. However, Audrey doesn't show up, causing Addie to doubt their friendship. Addie presents her case but struggles to connect with the council, mirroring Maggie's 16th-century defiance. The council rejects her application. Nina's vlog receives attention, but Keedie criticizes her for exploiting Addie's autism. They argue, and Addie receives a letter and an old key, possibly related to Maggie's story.
Medium Description: Addie's older sister Nina gives her a makeover. Later, when Addie gives a speech in front of the town council, she is heartbroken to find that her new best friend Audrey (Eve Midgley), who promised to support her, doesn't show up to hear her speech.
Short Description: Addie's older sister Nina gives her a makeover live on social media before Addie’s speech.
Xtra Short Description: Addie's sister Nina gives her a makeover on social media.

Long Description: Audrey apologizes to Addie for missing the meeting. Addie is researching Juniper's history of witches and has created a map and "witch list." Audrey believes that educating the villagers about the mistreatment of accused witches will garner support for a memorial. They go door-to-door, but face resistance and a warning from Miriam. Despite this, Audrey wants to be Addie's friend. Addie reads mean comments on Nina's uploaded video, and Keedie protects her. Frank unexpectedly joins them for dinner. Addie plans a double birthday party to reconcile with her sisters. In the past, Maggie, Beth, and Sarah resist the witch hunter, while Elinor seeks to protect her family.
Medium Description: Addie and Audrey's solidify their friendship when they go door to door to spread the word about the women who were wrongfully accused as witches. To heal the rift between her twin sisters, Addie plans a party for their upcoming birthday.
Short Description: Addie spreads the word of the women who were wrongfully accused as witches.
Xtra Short Description: Addie plans her twin sisters' birthday party.
Tiny Description: Addie plans her sisters' birthday party.

Long Description: The sisters (and Frank) go to the city. Addie and Frank visit the University Library for information on Maggie. Nina and Keedie shop at a vintage store, finding a dress and resolving sibling issues. In the past, Elinor plans a party to dispel witchcraft accusations. When the witch hunter nearly discovers Maggie's plot, Elinor invites Quinn to the party. Addie finds census records revealing Elinor accused Maggie of witchcraft. Addie is devastated and keeps the secret. Nina, Keedie, and Frank find Addie at the gallery. Addie contemplates a painting while Nina explains its significance to Keedie. Addie remains silent about her discovery. Addie calls Audrey, sharing the terrible news about Elinor. How could one betray their own sister?!
Medium Description: The Darrow sisters and Nina's boyfriend, Frank, go to the city in Addie's search for answers about Maggie's disappearance. While at the University library, Addie discovers some devastating information about Maggie's sister, Elinor.
Short Description: The Darrow sisters go to the city so Addie can find answers about Maggie’s disappearance.
Xtra Short Description: Addie goes to the city to learn more about Lady Margaret.
Tiny Description: Addie goes to the city for answers.

Long Description: It's Nina and Keedie's birthday party. Addie decorates the hall beautifully and hopes her sisters will get along. She thinks about Maggie and Elinor in the 16th century, determined to prevent her sisters from falling apart. Despite obstacles, the party goes well until Emily crashes and Keedie's autism becomes apparent. In the past, Maggie defends her friend and becomes a target. Addie and Keedie leave early, leaving Nina feeling left out. They discuss the challenges of being different in Juniper and Addie reveals information about Maggie and Elinor. Keedie senses there's more to the story. Meanwhile, Elinor acts strangely and goes into the woods, believing she's a witch. Afraid of the witch hunter, she tries to protect her family with a spell.
Medium Description: Despite Mr. MacIntosh's strict rules about using the town hall and Miss Murphy's attempts to shut it down, Addie’s birthday party for Nina and Keedie is a success. But when Addie's bully Emily crashes the party, things take a downward turn.
Short Description: Addie throws a sweet 16 for Nina and Keedie, but things take an unexpected turn for the worst.
Xtra Short Description: Nina and Keedie’s fabulous sweet 16 takes a downward turn.
Tiny Description: A crasher spoils the twins’ sweet 16.

Long Description: Addie fundraises for the memorial herself. Girls make posters and flyers for the "Nicest Village" competition in Juniper. Village council wants to maintain winning streak. Mr. Macintosh worries about girls' witch memorial stall. Keedie avoids new friends due to her autism. Nina avoids Frank in a town cryer's uniform. Addie's fundraising mishap ruins the crowning of Juniper's Queen. Miss Murphy tries to get Mr. Macintosh fired. Elinor's spell is discovered in the past. Maggie's attempt to get help ends in Beth's arrest by the witch hunter.
Medium Description: Keedie avoids her new friends out of fear they'll treat her differently if they know she has autism. Addie's fundraising campaign disrupts a beloved town event, which turns into the opportunity Miss Murphy needs to take control of the town council.
Short Description: Addie disrupts a town event, giving Miss Murphy the opportunity to take hold of the town council.
Xtra Short Description: Addie’s fundraising disrupts a beloved town event.
Tiny Description: Addie disrupts a beloved town event.

Long Description: With Miss Murphy as the council head, Addie and Audrey aim to impress her for their memorial by joining her Macbeth drama club. They become witches alongside Jenna, who reluctantly spends time with Addie while hiding it from jealous Emily. To prepare, Addie and Audrey plan a sleepover, but Mom accidentally invites Jenna too. Awkward. Despite tension, they have fun while Emily incessantly texts Jenna. Addie reads from the diary, revealing a failed 16th-century plan to rescue Beth. The sleepover unravels, as Keedie nearly exposes her secret with Miss Murphy. When Emily discovers Jenna's presence, Jenna wants to leave to avoid Emily's anger. In the 16th century, Elinor hinders Maggie from saving Beth, leading to Maggie's arrest by Quinn. Elinor is devastated.
Medium Description: Addie's mom accidentally invites Jenna to Addie and Audrey's slumber party. Addie reads from Lady Margaret's diary about her attempt to rescue her servant, Beth. Jenna questions Keedie on the rift between her and Miss Murphy.
Short Description: Jenna is accidentally invited to Addie and Audrey’s sleepover and upsets Keedie with her questions.
Xtra Short Description: Jenna is accidentally invited to Addie's slumber party.

Long Description: It's the school play day. Addie and Audrey aim for a great performance, then ask Miss Murphy about the witch memorial. Since she's the council head now, it's their only chance. Addie struggles with her opening lines. Nothing sticks in her head. She hides a script in Maggie's diary, but Miss Murphy confiscates it. All hope seems lost until Mr Allison tapes the lines to a prop. Addie gets through the opening scenes. The show succeeds, but Emily overhears Addie, Audrey, and Jenna talking about her. Jealousy consumes her, leading to revenge—destroying Addie's diary, labeling her a freak." Emily taunts Addie, who pushes her as Miss Murphy enters. Emily accuses Addie for no reason. Addie is taken away, but Keedie and Nina rescue her from an angry Miss Murphy. In 16th century Juniper, Elinor is heartbroken by Maggie's arrest. She meets kind-hearted Robin and other players, understanding her feelings and finding strength to fight Quinn. Elinor plans to rescue her sister at any cost!
Medium Description: Backstage drama threatens the school's production of Macbeth. Emily's jealousy reaches a breaking point and lashes out at Addie. Nina and Keedie must then rescue their little sister from the wrath of Miss Murphy.
Short Description: After the performance of Macbeth, Addie is bullied by Emily and unfairly punished by Miss Murphy.
Xtra Short Description: Backstage drama during Macbeth leaves Addie distressed.
Tiny Description: Addie tries to navigate backstage drama.

Long Description: Addie suspended, Keedie exhausted by showdown with Miss Murphy. Nina feels left out, distracted by Frank's lost tortoise hunt. Keedie worsens, mom calls doctor. Addie tries to reach her sister. They go to a rural spot, leap like Red Coat. Keedie feels better, reveals truth about Miss Murphy. Return home, Addie's school hearing next day. Elinor plans to rescue Maggie from Quinn, but will it work?
Medium Description: Both at low points following their confrontations with Miss Murphy, Addie and Keedie turn to each other for healing. Frank creates a much-needed diversion for Nina when he recruits her to help him find a lost turtle.
Short Description: Addie and Keedie turn to each other in the aftermath of their confrontations with Miss Murphy.
Xtra Short Description: Addie and Keedie try to heal after confronting Miss Murphy.
Tiny Description: Addie and Keedie try to heal together.

Long Description: Addie, her parents, Nina, and Keedie attend a school meeting regarding Addie's potential permanent exclusion. Despite initial setbacks, Audrey and Frank discover the truth about Maggie's rescue and share it with Jenna. Jenna presents evidence against Miss Murphy, and Keedie exposes Murphy's derogatory remark. Murphy's ableist outburst reveals her true nature. Addie receives a short exclusion but can return next term. The family files a complaint against Murphy. Audrey reveals the heroic act of Elinor, who stood up for Maggie. Addie feels a connection with Elinor, believing she may also be autistic. Addie makes a powerful plea to the village council, uniting the community and advocating for a memorial to honor mistreated women. Being different wasn't a crime then, nor is it now!
Medium Description: Addie's fate at her school is decided. Audrey and Frank discover the amazing story of Lady Margaret's escape, inspiring Addie to make one final plea to the town for a memorial for young women wrongfully accused as witches.

Long Description: Jean-Claude Vanaquer, Director of the Paris Institute, was born in France's Champagne region and moved to Australia in 1971, where his family converted to the gospel. His spiritual journey deepened during his mission in the Paris Toulouse area. After military service, he entered the business world, becoming a regional director for a laminate company before moving into kitchen sales. Later, encouraged to apply, he became a Seminary and Institute coordinator for the Church, starting in Lyon. Now Director of the French Seminary Institute area, he is committed to teaching and mentoring young adults, fostering their spiritual growth. Jean-Claude's professional journey is equally compelling. After completing his military service, he ventured into the business world, eventually rising to the position of regional director for a laminate company and later working in kitchen sales. His career took a significant turn when he was encouraged to apply for a position with the Church as a Seminary and Institute coordinator. Jean-Claude has played a crucial role in developing and supporting Institute programs, starting in Lyon and later serving in various locations. Jean-Claude has taken on the additional role of Director of the French Seminary Institute area, further expanding his influence and responsibilities. His commitment to teaching and mentoring young adults has been a cornerstone of his work, reflecting his dedication to fostering spiritual growth and resilience among the youth.

Eves Otto, 22, is a psychology student from near Paris, France, and a devoted member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The Gospel deeply influences her life. Passionate about travel, Eves is the youngest of five, with a rich family heritage—her father’s roots in Guadeloupe and her maternal grandparents from mainland France. Initially studying Archeology and Art History at Panthéon Sorbonne, she shifted to psychology at Sorbonne Paris Nord. Eves plans to join Air France as cabin crew, improving her English and Spanish while traveling. She served a mission in the France Lyon Mission and holds church roles in Primary and as Young Women President. As the youngest of five siblings, Eves's family background is diverse and rich in cultural heritage. Eves's mother played a crucial role in teaching her about God, prayer, and the commandments. 

After exploring Archeology and Art History at Panthéon Sorbonne, Eves transitioned to psychology at the University of Sorbonne Paris Nord, where he is currently immersed in understanding the human mind. Eves plans to join Air France as a cabin crew member and is eager to improve her English and Spanish while traveling the world. Her church service includes a mission in the France Lyon Mission and roles in Primary and as the Young Women President in her branch.

Long Description: Kirby travels to Phoenix, Arizona, where he joins The Welcome to America Project, an organization that helps refugees arriving in the United States to flourish in their new home. Kirby visits families from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Syria, learning about the difficult journeys they have endured, and the needs they have as they begin their new lives in Phoenix. Together with dozens of volunteers, Kirby tracks down needed items and experiences the outpouring of love that occurs as they are delivered to the families.

Long Description: Kirby revs his engine all the way to Temecula, California where he gets a taste of adrenaline therapy with Warfighter Made, a nonprofit dedicated to putting wounded veterans behind the wheels of off-road vehicles. Working to prep the custom vehicles for a gathering of veterans at a local racetrack, Kirby gets to know the individuals being served by the organization, and the sacrifices they've made for their country. On the big day, engines roar as loudly as Kirby's screams, as the veterans drive aggressively around the track, fly off jumps, fishtail around corners, and put smiles on the faces of everyone involved.

Alongside an army of volunteer bed-builders, Kirby and the Sleep in Heavenly Peace team build 130 beds in a single day. Long Description: Kawser in Bangladesh attends a unique floating school, built on a boat due to frequent flooding. The project, funded globally, offers the children access to education and technology, providing them a window to the world. In a swimming competition, Kawser aims to win a solar lamp, enabling him to study and play after dark. Meanwhile, in Denmark, Stella attends a roleplaying school with a weekly motto; this week's theme is "Titanic." The classroom transforms into a ship's cabin, and students engage in activities like building lifeboats. Stella's task is to rescue those unable to construct their own boats, though the method remains a surprise until the last minute.

Long Description: Soumya attends the world's largest school in India, while Keanen studies in a fun-filled school in the USA. Keanen's school is inspired by "Harry Potter," with dancing, singing, video games, and rocking teachers. In this fantasy-like system, Keanen aims to be the house leader. Meanwhile, Soumya navigates the vast City Montessori School with 55,000 students. She dreams of becoming a software engineer and stands out by preparing for a singing competition. Will Keanen pass his test and rock the rap recital? Can Soumya impress her 700 peers with a Hindi song and win the first prize?

Long Description: Mía lives in Paraguay but commutes daily to school in Argentina. Miro studies in a New Zealand rainforest clearing. Mía's journey to school is arduous. She resides near the Paraguay-Argentina border with her grandparents. Many Paraguayan women give birth in Argentina, granting their children Argentine nationality and access to free education there. Mía travels by boat and foot for an hour each way. Today, she feels anxious as she must present her homeland, perform a dance, and sing in Guaraní, her native language. Miro resides in Auckland, New Zealand. Four days a week, she attends a regular public school, while the fifth day is spent at forest school in the rainforest. Miro learns practical skills like fire-starting, tree-climbing, and mud-play, along with hands-on lessons on natural sciences. Her current task involves leading her group in constructing a buoyant raft for safe sea-crossing. Conflict arises, testing Miro's ability to unite her team and successfully launch the raft.

Long Description: Rise is a powerful collection of short stories that explores how religious education can illuminate paths, strengthen character, and inspire real change in the lives of students. Each story offers a unique glimpse into the personal journeys of young people who, through spiritual learning and guidance, rise above challenges, discover purpose, and grow into leaders of compassion, resilience, and hope. Grounded in truth and transformation, Rise celebrates the quiet but profound impact of faith in education.

Long Description: Arien faced her parents' divorce, her father's death, her brother's rare cancer death, mental health struggles, and COVID disruptions that threatened her high school graduation. Believing university was out of reach, she moved to Zimbabwe, discovered BYU-Pathway, served a mission in London, and—through inspired help and a miracle visa approval—enrolled at BYU-Idaho. Studying communications, she now breaks family cycles and finds deep meaning in learning thanks to faith.

Long Description: Jay struggled from the start when he failed first grade, battled through school, and barely graduated high school. Jay loved learning but never connected with traditional classrooms. Though deeply religious, he saw no link between faith and education. After failing out of college, marriage and renewed spiritual promptings brought him back. Faith is reshaping his view of education, helping him overcome weaknesses, and proving that with Christ, learning becomes possible and purposeful.
Medium Description: From failing first grade to failing out of college, Jay’s path was rocky. Though he loved learning, classrooms never fit, and faith felt unrelated. Marriage and spiritual renewal changed that. Now his faith fuels growth he once thought impossible.
Short Description: Faith at Ensign College is helping Jay Cannon learn to overcome lifelong academic struggles.
Xtra Short Description: Faith redeems Jay's education at Ensign College.

Long Description: Kyla loved going to school and had big college plans. One day while writing her blog, an ad for BYU Pathway popped up and she enrolled on the spot. Now married with three little kids she’d found the needed ‘pathway’ to the education she’d always dreamed of.

As the first in his family to pursue college, he faced no religious discussion in public education and relied on personal efforts for spiritual moments in school. Because he served a Church mission his higher education ambitions were dashed in China, but Church membership led him to the iWORK program at BYU-Hawaii. Faith now guides his accounting and supply chain studies.

Long Description: Hinatea was born on the small island of Huahine in Tahiti. There was no high school on her island so as a 15-year-old she had to travel by boat to another island where she lived with strangers. Hinatea’s family was abusive and suffered from drug and alcohol addictions. They also had no goals for themselves or their children. Despite their disapproval Hinatea joined The Church and dreamed of going to BYU-Hawaii. A dream that came true after she discovered BYU Pathway.
Medium Description: Born on the small island of Huahine in Tahiti, Hinatea traveled by boat each day just to attend high school. With few expectations set before her, she dreamed of BYU–Hawaii. Through BYU–Pathway, that distant dream became reality.
Short Description: Hinatea dreamed of going to BYU-Hawaii. After discovering BYU Pathway, her dream came true.
Xtra Short Description: Through BYU Pathway Hinatea made it to BYU-Hawaii.

Long Description: Nikki is a single mom and a convert to The Church. She grew up in a home of poverty and anger. She struggled at school, eventually flunking college after one semester. Nikki takes a "road trip" to Arizona with her daughter to visit the town where she barely graduated high school. Memories are triggered, both painful and positive as she connects her past to her present, and looks forward to the next chapter in her life. She explores how Faith and Education are inextricably linked in her life.
Medium Description: Returning to the Arizona town she once struggled to leave, Nikki brings her daughter along for the ride. In facing her past, she sees how faith and education became the foundation of her future.
Short Description: Nikki takes a "road trip" to explore how Faith and Education are inextricably linked in her life.
Xtra Short Description: Nikki explores her faith and education journey.

Long Description: Kareisha Hartsfield is about to graduate from Colorado Christian University. After earning a certificate in Biblical Studies, she’s completed an Associate Degree in Human Resources. A veteran of the Afghanistan conflict and mother of two—one who overcame a life-threatening illness—Kareisha’s journey is extraordinary. Growing up in rural Arkansas, university seemed out of reach, but thanks to faith, support, and her own determination, she’s achieved her academic dreams. Kareisha shows that when odds are against you, God has your back. She embodies the transformative power of faith-based education and aims to inspire others to trust in God and pursue their own miracles.
Medium Description: Kareisha, an Afghanistan veteran and mother, overcame obstacles to graduate from Colorado Christian University. With faith and support, she proves that when life’s odds are against you, God’s support helps transform dreams into reality.

Long Description: During her space battle with the Gundreen, Carla gets infected with a deadly weaponised virus with no known cure. The Bennetts must work together to find an antidote that can save her life. We learn from Old Bennett, that finding a cure is imperative not only to save Mom but the world as well. With Carla on sick leave at home, Crumb decides it’s time to put on his old Guardian uniform and replaces her in the field with hilarious unintended results. The Bennetts figure out that the Gundreen virus is organic.  If they can source some Gundreen DNA maybe they can concoct medicine to cure her. Our two heroes jerry-rig a Guardian suit that will fit Bennett and they blast off into space to look for DNA in the Gundreen spy ship wreckage. The mission nearly goes off the rails, but the Bennetts miraculously retrieve the DNA and return home only to discover it was all for naught. Their concoction fails and Mom is dying. Bennett remembers the elixir in the Vault that saved the Tragonian Prince.  Old Bennett pleads with Bennett not to take the elixir. He stole it in his timeline and it caused an intergalactic war. He whisks his younger self to a vision of an Armageddon future on Earth.  The reason Old Bennett created the mind share device in the first place was to prevent his younger self from taking the elixir and propelling the world into war. Bennett uses a device to sever all contact with Old Bennett when his older self refuses to help him save Mom.
Medium Description: Carla gets infected with a deadly virus. The Bennetts race against time to find a cure. When their antidote fails, Bennett decides to steal the Tragonian elixir.  Old Bennett reveals he too stole the elixir propelling Earth into an intergalactic war.

Long Description: While scoping out the DGS spacecraft hangar, Bennett learns from Old Bennett about the existence of scary looking aliens called the Gundreen.  When Bennett spies the SS Starbound, a DGS spacecraft, he decides to sneak on board to check it out.  When Carla arrives in full Guardian gear to fly the craft, Bennett stows away and inadvertently joins his mom on a mission to fix a malfunctioning satellite.  Bennett had promised Liam he would help him build a model rocket for his science class. But with Bennett now unavailable Liam turns to Sophie for help. Carla explains to Bennett that the satellite works as a cloaking device protecting Earth by preventing the Gundreen from discovering the existence their planet. Without it, the Gundreen would invade Earth and take control of the DGS and the Vault. The mission looks like it was successful until Carla spots a Gundreen spy ship.  Meanwhile, after several false starts, Liam and Sophie successfully launch their rocket. Back in space, the Gundreen fires a laser blast which sends the satellite tumbling towards Earth on a collision course with Star City. Bennett takes control of the SS Starbound in order to retrieve the satellite while Carla goes after the Gundreen. Bennett manages to recover the satellite and rejoins his mom as she battles the Gundreen.  When all seems lost, Liam and Sophie’s rocket appears out of nowhere, taking out the Gundreen but not before the alien fires a weapon grazing Carla’s shoulder.  Bennett and Carla return home to a hero’s welcome. But Old Bennett knows that Carla has been gravely wounded.

Long Description: Bennett stealing the Tragonian elixir causes major problems for the DGS. The Intergalactic Alliance sends Comptroller Breylax and her assistant Gordo to Earth where they demand answers from Crumb about how the DGS Vault was breached. If they discover anything is missing, the IGA will remove the Vault from DGS control and Earth will be drawn into the intergalactic war. By day 27, most have gathered, but the Artefact remains untouched. They pass time with fires, stone-skimming, and sleep. Dev grows frustrated by Jay and Kaz's closeness, sparking tension. Long Description: Millions of the world's poorest (mostly women) who are unable to provide the necessary collateral to secure a traditional loan are turning to microcredit institutions for help. Long Description: Two years after a catastrophic earthquake struck Nepal, many continue to live with the repercussions of the seismic disaster. Host Paul Foster connects with his Nepalese friends to undertake a tough, dangerous, and exhilarating 14-hour drive up the mountains in a special delivery of masonry that will help rebuild schools and bring children back into the classroom.
Medium Description: After a major earthquake in Nepal, Paul Foster packs up construction materials and makes the journey up a mountain to rebuild a school, bringing education back to the community.

Long Description: In the heart of Jaffna, Sri Lanka, lies a village in Kilinochchi with a remarkable story. In a country known for its recent pain of civil strife and its love of Cricket, a group of teenage girls have decided to form a soccer team and bend it like Beckham. Nothing unusual about that, except that these girls have made it to third spot in the National Soccer League - and are doing so without even the most basic soccer gear - not even a single pair of boots. Host Pei Fen lugs her special delivery of boots onto a train - for the long ride from Colombo to Kilinochchi, but not before encountering unexpected problems along the way. But despite the stress, she presses on - eager to help the girls put the tragic past behind and look forward to a brighter future.

Host Carla Dunareanu partners with Bridging the Gap Mekong Trust to travel upriver to a remote village in her special delivery of mosquito-nets and precious medical supplies.

But there are some who still follow the old hunter-gatherer ways. Host Paul Foster journeys up the Tembeling River and into the primeval forest in search of just such a community from the Batek tribe to deliver rice and clothes to to help them cope as their way of life is threatened by modernity.

Long Description: For some years now, a mobile horse library helmed by a stable hand has been making its rounds around the villages of Serang. It's almost a quixotic quest to tackle Indonesia's low literacy by encouraging reading. Host Khai Saharom joins Ridwan Sururi in this endearing and noble effort to bring books to the villagers. On his journey, he meets Lasmi, a very shy young autistic girl whom Ridwan has successfully taught to read.

Long Description:
A family finds hope, healing, and strength together as they restart their lives in a neighborhood where the fantastic and the mundane curiously exist.

Newly single mom Lucy uproots her two children, 12-year-old Klara and six-year-old Pim, to the suburbs, only to find that life in this new neighborhood is no less complicated than where they came from. But with the help of their wondrous neighbors and loving grandparents, the family finds a new way forward.

Based on the book by Academy Award® winner Shaun Tan (2011, Best Short Film, Animated, The Lost Thing), Tales from Outer Suburbia is a visually-stunning animated series that combines imagination and inspiration.
